title: SkyReels V2 launches an unlimited-length AI video model #SkyReelsV2 #opensourceai #aivideo
description: SkyWork AI released SkyReels V2, an open source AI video model capable of generating unlimited length videos beyond the typical 15-second limit. It achieves this by using diffusion forcing, a technique that extends video continuity by predicting frames based on previous content rather than stitching separate clips together. SkyReels V2 accepts text prompts or reference images to create high-quality visuals that rival paid tools like Kling and Runway. Users can either download the model weights from Hugging Face for local use requiring an RTX 4090 GPU or access the official SkyReels website with free credits for easier setup. This innovation broadens access to advanced video generation tools, pushing the boundaries of AI creativity and content creation by removing previous limitations on video length in the open source space. #SkyWorkAI #SkyReelsV2 #AIvideoGeneration #DiffusionForcing #OpenSourceAI #HuggingFace #RTX4090 #AIcreativity #VideoAI #RunwayML #KlingAI #AIVideoTools #AIGeneratedVideo #MachineLearning #GenerativeAI
